responsibility: This host-side generator emits version.h from build-time version macros such as BASEVER, DEVPHASE, DATESTAMP, REVISION, PKGVERSION, and BUGURL. It parses the GCC major/minor version, constructs the encoded four-byte GCOV_VERSION signature used by coverage data compatibility checks, and writes the standard version_string, pkgversion_string, bug-report URL, and GCC_major_version definitions consumed across the compiler.
